# Copilot Instructions: Social Bingo\n\nPurpose: Give AI agents concise, actionable context for coding in this workspace. Follow patterns, conventions, and tests below.\n\nProject Overview:\n- Single-page React app (Vite + Tailwind v4). Entry: src/main.tsx -> src/App.tsx.\n- UI components (src/components) are small, presentational, and props-driven. Prefer composing components rather than a global store.\n- Game logic resides in src/utils/bingoLogic.ts; tests are in src/utils/bingoLogic.test.ts.\n- Persistent UI state is managed locally by src/hooks/useBingoGame.ts and saved to localStorage (STORAGE_KEY).\n\nKey Files/Patterns:\n- src/utils/bingoLogic.ts: core board generation and bingo detection. Use this to add game rules or modify win conditions.\n- src/hooks/useBingoGame.ts: orchestrates state, localStorage, and transitions (start -> playing -> bingo). Use SSR guards for window/localStorage checks.\n- src/data/questions.ts: single source of truth for question strings. Questions are shuffled and limited to 24 for a 5x5 board with a free center.\n- Styling: src/index.css uses Tailwind v4's @theme variables. Use those tokens (eg. --color-accent) via Tailwind utilities (bg-accent, etc.).\n\nDevelopment Commands (important):\n- Install: npm ci\n- Dev: npm run dev (vite - opens at http://localhost:5173)\n- Build: npm run build\n- Lint: npm run lint (ESLint + ts rules)\n- Test: npm test (Vitest)\n\nDesign & Implementation Guidance for Agents:\n- State changes should be immutable; bingo logic returns new arrays (toggleSquare). Verify no in-place mutations.\n- The board is 5x5 (25 squares), center index 12 is always free. Use constants (BOARD_SIZE, CENTER_INDEX) in modifications.\n- Avoid adding global state; prefer small composable hooks and prop drilling.\n- Persisted localStorage shape and versioning handled in useBingoGame. Validate migrations by checking STORAGE_VERSION and the validator function.\n\nTesting & CI:\n- Use Vitest for unit tests. Tests live alongside implementation in src/utils for core logic. Use mocks/spies via Vi when needed (see existing tests).\n- Always update or add tests for new game mechanics or UI-critical behavior.\n\nStyling & Tailwind v4 Patterns:\n- Use @theme variables in src/index.css; prefer css tokens for brand colors.\n- Keep utilities simple; follow existing component class patterns (BEM-like semantics are not enforced).\n\nCommon Gotchas & Warnings:\n- Do not change board ID ranges (0-24) without updating tests and UI.\n- LocalStorage data validation is strict. If migrating versions, update STORAGE_VERSION and write careful migration logic.\n- Avoid toggling the free space at index 12; toggleSquare explicitly ignores free spaces.\n\nHow to Add a Feature (recommended sequence):\n1. Add/modify unit tests in src/utils (target business logic).\n2. Implement logic in src/utils/bingoLogic.ts and update types in src/types if needed.\n3. Update useBingoGame to integrate state changes and persistence.\n4. Adjust or add UI components in src/components and update tests for those components.\n5. Run: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build.\n\nIf youre unsure where to change behavior, try the following locations:\n- Game rules: src/utils/bingoLogic.ts, tests in src/utils/bingoLogic.test.ts\n- Save/restore behavior: src/hooks/useBingoGame.ts\n- UI: src/components/ (StartScreen, GameScreen, BingoBoard)\n\nAsk the repository owner if: you want to change the project shape (change board size, add external APIs, or change data persistence).
